key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Used for the top bar and for the open panel. App and process figures are only read while the panel is open.

key.name: show-bars
key.summary: Show two small usage bars next to the icon
key.description: One for the processor and one for memory.

key.name: show-numbers
key.summary: Show processor and memory figures next to the icon

key.name: memory-format
key.summary: Show memory in the top bar as a percentage or an amount

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Place the icon to the left or the right of the system menu

key.name: cpu-per-core
key.description: Off: 100% means the whole processor is busy. On: 100% means one core is busy, so a busy app can show more than 100%.

key.summary: List processes of other users and the system

key.summary: Ask before ending an app or process
